access: Only this WhatsApp chat; never open or read any other chat, contact, channel or subgroup. Read source listings only; never send messages.

televisions.rule: Only TVs with an explicitly verified diagonal of exactly 32, 43 or 55 inches. Wholesale USD plus the size-specific markup, with no rounding. Do not import any other size or infer size from arbitrary model digits.

perfumeBrands: All brands, only original Arabic perfumes explicitly identified by source. Never replicas or equivalents.
existingOtherPhones: Preserve existing Tecno and similar phones. Do not archive them. New models outside the approved brands require clarification.
matching: Exact model, storage, RAM, configuration, condition and color. Never use a used/swap/CPO quote to reprice a new sealed phone. Ambiguous listings stay pending.
offers: Only explicit current supplier OFERTA/LIQUIDACION or a verified decrease for the exact variant; never infer a discount from a margin change or invent an old price.
inventory: Preserve existing stock. Never reset stocks to 10 or infer stock quantity from availability. New variants require verified photos and stock/availability handling compatible with the store.
otherCategories: Do not import products outside these categories and the approved TV sizes. Preserve manually managed JBL. Do not automatically delete existing catalog items.
priority: Latest dated source for the exact variant wins. Persist evidence and processing state; never overwrite a newer quote with an older PDF.
verification: Back up affected products, guard against concurrent edits, read back all applied changes. Keep uncertain products pending with a reason.
